instruction: The precondition file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file; it contains the base part shown in the before image and sketch(es) you will need. Build the target shape shown in the after image by adding the revolved groove and pocket operations from the supplied sketches. Use Sketch001 to create the first Groove as a 360 degree cut around the Y axis. Use Sketch002 to create the pocket with a 50 mm depth, cutting in the reversed direction. Use Sketch003 to create the second Groove as a 360 degree cut around the Y axis. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
